title: GL Breaker
description: So basically, this doesn't ACTUALLY BREAK OpenGL. It instead causes visual effects with the /glbreaker command. If you've experienced epilepsy or any form of seizures in the past, do NOT play this mod!
body:
This mod adds some effects that run on OpenGL [at least not yet. This is an alpha project and there's no OpenGL junk yet.]

I got bored and decided to throw this crappy mod together. 
This mod was made in MCreator but it was mainly made in the code editor.

The command to toggle these effects is /glbreaker
